name: md-publisher
description: Turn markdown documents (with embedded mermaid) into themed, searchable, paged PDFs and Microsoft Word DOCX files via WeasyPrint and python-docx. 6 skills (publish, preprocess, theme-advisor, theme-gallery, install-fonts, rebuild-themes) + 8 bundled themes (atlas/phosphor/arcade/signal in light + dark) + interactive custom-theme creation
longDescription:
md-publisher is the WeasyPrint-based winner of a four-toolchain bake-off, now extended with a full DOCX pipeline (winner of a separate three-toolchain DOCX bake-off). It produces print-ready PDFs and editable Word documents from any markdown source, with full mermaid support — diagram node labels survive as searchable text in both formats (Ctrl+F finds them). Themes are interchangeable per (theme, mode) across both outputs, and a custom theme can be created interactively via the theme-advisor skill in under 5 minutes.

Includes: page covers with title/subtitle/author/date derived from YAML front matter or first h1; auto-resize for oversized mermaid diagrams; per-node coloring via universal `:::ingress / :::core / :::transform / :::bridge` tags; per-platform font detection + install via the install-fonts skill so DOCX output renders identically to PDF; separate user-themes directory under `~/.md-publisher/themes/` so customizations persist across plugin updates.

skills.name: publish
skills.summary: Render markdown to a themed PDF or DOCX (or both)

skills.name: preprocess
skills.summary: LLM-tag mermaid diagrams for theme-aware coloring

skills.name: theme-advisor
skills.summary: Interactive Q&A flow that creates a custom theme

skills.name: theme-gallery
skills.summary: List + preview built-in and user-installed themes

skills.name: install-fonts
skills.summary: Per-platform detect + install of theme fonts so DOCX renders identically to PDF

skills.name: rebuild-themes
skills.summary: Refresh installed themes after a plugin upgrade by re-deriving mermaid-config + preview from each theme's spec

system: GTK 3 runtime (Pango / Cairo / GDK-Pixbuf) — on Windows the easiest source is Inkscape or GIMP; on Linux apt install libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libgdk-pixbuf2.0-0; on macOS brew install pango cairo gdk-pixbuf libffi

firstRunBehavior: On first invocation of any skill, the plugin auto-installs a Python venv (WeasyPrint, markdown, Pygments, Pillow, python-docx, markdown-it-py, cairosvg, pytest) and Node deps (mermaid-cli + Puppeteer Chromium) to ~/.md-publisher/runtime/. Takes ~2 minutes; downloads ~250 MB; subsequent runs reuse the cache.
